A sheet of newsprint measures 560 mm by 430 mm.
Each square metre of newsprint has a mass of 42 g.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Show that the mass of one sheet of newsprint is 0.0101 kilograms, correct to 3 significant figures.
[3]

Work out the mass of this newspaper in kilograms.
................................................. [1]

parts.text:

The newspaper has an average circulation of 950 000.

parts.label: i

Give your answer in tonnes.
................................................. [2]

parts.text:
The newspaper is made every day from Monday to Friday each week.
Work out the mass of newsprint, in tonnes, used in a year of 52 weeks.
Give your answer correct to the nearest thousand.
................................................. [2]
